dispatch._note: Zone board + auto-dispatch defaults for this client. Zone shapes are drawn in the admin Zone Editor; this list only seeds names and order.

rideRules._note: Pickup timing for app rides. Call-in and guest-without-account rides never pay these fees.

appHandles._note: Rides the app runs on its own (driver and rider work it out). Everything else goes to the dispatcher to send by radio: phone calls, guests, cash, no GPS, ID not verified yet.

rideRules._stopNote: Stops during a ride: the meter keeps running while the car waits. After stopEndTripMinutes the driver may end the trip and charge the meter so far; at stillWaitingCheckMinutes his phone asks if he's still waiting.

ridePerks._note: Who gets the live driver map and the private Call-your-driver button. DAY_PASS = the $5 Priority Day Pass. Drivers can always call their rider.

calling._note: Private calls go through the Twilio number in functions/.env; nobody sees a real number. Blank Twilio keys = calls show the office number instead.
calling.greeting: Connecting you now. This call may be recorded for quality and safety.

dayPassCopy.title: Priority Day Pass
dayPassCopy.tagline: Get picked up faster, all day.
perks: Move up the line ahead of regular riders
Watch your driver on the map as they come to you
Call your driver directly. It’s private, and no numbers are shared.
dayPassCopy.fine: Good until midnight. Same place in line as Premium members. Your driver may not pick up while driving and will call back when it’s safe.

cardFee._note: Card fee riders pay. 'none' (chosen Nov 23: same price cash or card), 'credit_surcharge' (credit up to creditPercent, never above processing cost; debit/prepaid $0; needs 30-day card-network notice) or 'flat' (old $2/$1.80).

cardCost._note: What the card company takes per card charge (Stripe standard online: 2.9% + 30c). paidBy 'driver': taken from the driver's card-fare credit (tips stay 100% his); 'company': the company pays it.

memberDeals._note: Deals for signed-in riders. priceLock: card rides never cost more than the top of the price shown (company covers the gap; driver gets the full meter). welcomeCreditCents: off the first card ride. Plan members earn tiers.X.rewardCents of ride credit every rewardEveryRides rides of rewardMinFareCents or more. Credit comes off the next card ride automatically.

driverMeter._note: Driver types the meter at drop-off and the rider's saved card is charged. A meter far above the trip estimate goes to the office instead.

estimate._note: Price shown before booking. roadFactor turns straight-line miles into road miles; highMultiplier sets the top of the range; past maxMiles the rider is asked to call.

support._note: Problem reports (Report a problem / Ask dispatch) are saved and emailed to these addresses. Fill in when handing over.
